lines.1: 「Maybe I'll borrow Sato for a day.」
lines.3: Sato turned bright red in an instant.
lines.5: For some reason, Subaru looked pleased.
lines.6: 「Fine. But she's mine, so make sure you return her afterward.」
lines.7: 「Whoa, Yoppi! She's treating you like an object!」
lines.8: 「Ahaha, it's fine. Ellie isn't serious either.」
lines.9: 「Probably... Sixty percent... That's what I want to believe...」
lines.10: 「It was a joke. You don't have to take it that seriously.」
